subject.title: Overview Event Log and Gateway Log panels do not stay aligned when their content heights differ

question: Should ClawHub own this reported Overview Event Log/Gateway Log UI, or should the issue be transferred/recreated against another OpenClaw dashboard repository?
rationale: Current ClawHub main does not contain the described route, panels, or CSS classes, so automation cannot determine the owning product surface or implement a narrow layout fix safely.

options.title: Route To Owning Dashboard
options.body: Identify the repository or route that contains `ov-event-log` and `ov-log-tail`, then transfer or recreate the issue with the existing reproduction details.

options.title: Add ClawHub Ownership First
options.body: If this Overview page is intended to live in ClawHub, create or locate the route/component before attempting the equal-height layout fix.

options.title: Request Reporter Evidence
options.body: Ask the reporter for a screenshot, URL path, and current checkout link before deciding whether this is a ClawHub issue.

recommendation.title: Route To Owning Dashboard
recommendation.body: Identify the repository or route that contains `ov-event-log` and `ov-log-tail`, then transfer or recreate the issue with the existing reproduction details.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently landed the current ClawHub dashboard workspace, the closest present surface to this report.
